title: You're Hallucinating Right Now 👁️
caption:
Neuroscientist Anil Seth calls perception a controlled hallucination.

Your brain isn't a camera. It guesses what's out there and uses your senses to check the guess. That's why a hollow mask still looks like a face.

Which level broke your brain? 👇
